messages:
tara (devex): FYI support escalated: quickstart app's `redwoodctl localtest` is hitting a customer's hosted account instead of the local docker service. they ran through the quickstart verbatim.
rafael (eng-platform): whoa. any repro steps from the customer?
tara (devex): paste from user: 
```
# followed quickstart
redwoodctl profile create --name quickstart --url http://127.0.0.1:8080
redwoodctl profile use quickstart
redwoodctl localtest start
# app makes auth call, but hits https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/...
```
priya (eng-runtime): that implies the active profile resolved to the hosted endpoint. what's `redwoodctl profile list --verbose` show?
tara (devex): they attached a screenshot: profile list shows quickstart (local) as active, but localtest logs show HOSTED_BASE_URL env=\"https://api.redwood-inference.com\"
leo (devops): hmm, are we merging legacy ~/.redwood/config.json with XDG config? we changed precedence in 2.1.4 to prefer XDG but maybe the code path that builds the runtime env still reads the old file first.
rafael (eng-platform): I think this is the precedence bug we talked about in planning: RWCTL_ACTIVE_PROFILE env should override disk config, then XDG, then legacy. if code accidentally uses legacy first it may return wrong base_url.
tara (devex): customer also noted they had `RWCTL_PROFILE=hosted` exported in their zshrc for a previous POC, but they expected `profile use quickstart` to take effect in interactive shell.
priya (eng-runtime): aha, environment variable precedence should be: explicit CLI `use` command updates the active profile in XDG and should override env for current process only; but we didn't update the in-memory env when running `profile use` via the background watcher helper. bug.
leo (devops): short repro:
```
export RWCTL_PROFILE=hosted
redwoodctl profile create --name quickstart --url http://127.0.0.1:8080
redwoodctl profile use quickstart
# but background agent still injects RWCTL_PROFILE=hosted into localtest child process
redwoodctl localtest start
```
rafael (eng-platform): right — the issue is the localtest launcher spawns the app with environment snapshot from the systemd/agent process which had the old env. `profile use` updates config on disk but doesn't signal the agent to refresh env.
tara (devex): customer was confused because `profile use quickstart` prints "Switched to profile quickstart" and later `localtest` logs claim quickstart active in startup banner. inconsistent.
priya (eng-runtime): proposed fixes: 1) make `profile use` emit a short signal to the local agent (unix socket or UDS) to refresh its environment cache, 2) localtest should always read profile from disk at spawn time (not rely on parent's env snapshot), 3) warn if RWCTL_PROFILE is set in environment and CLI command will override only for the explicit process (helpful hint).
leo (devops): agree on 1+2. 3 is low effort and helpful for onboarding. also add telemetry when localtest detects mismatched base_url between env and disk.
rafael (eng-platform): small UX consideration: we must not silently change behavior for CI where env variables are expected to be authoritative. suggest heuristics: if RWCTL_PROFILE set and user ran `profile use` in the same shell session, prefer recent CLI action; if not, respect RWCTL_PROFILE. we can approximate by checking process start ts vs last profile-modified ts.
priya (eng-runtime): good idea. implement steps: - update profile manager to write a profile-modified timestamp - when launching localtest, compare snapshot timestamp to profile file mtime and prefer newer. If env RWCTL_PROFILE differs and is newer than disk, respect env. else respect disk. fallback to CLI arg.
tara (devex): for support reply, i'll give them the workaround: unset RWCTL_PROFILE in the shell, re-run `profile use quickstart`, then `localtest start`. Also add a note in quickstart that global env vars can shadow local profiles.
leo (devops): i'll add a short patch to localtest launcher to always read config file at spawn and pass explicit --profile flag to the child process to avoid env drift.
rafael (eng-platform): i'll create GH issue GH#4720 summarizing: "localtest may launch with stale RWCTL_PROFILE env from agent; profile use doesn't signal agent" and assign to priya for runtime changes + leo for launcher patch.
ticket-bot: created ticket GH#4720: "localtest launches with stale profile env; profile use doesn't refresh agent"
tara (devex): thanks. adding docs note and raising quickstart onboarding blurb. closing once PRs merge. :white_check_mark:
